hero.caption:
Former GWR 0-4-0ST on Gwili Railway at Bronwydd Arms, 1992.
Acquired by the heritage Gwili Railway, but currently working on Bryan Nicholl's private sidingat at Gotherington (Gloucestershire & Warwickshire Railway), No. 1144 had been until 9/48 GWR No. 974, built by Hawthorn Leslie in 1909 for the Swansea Harbour Trust and withdrawn by BR in 1/60.

images.caption:
I think this was taken in 1991.  I would have been 16 at the time, and was helping out on the Gwili Railway's stand inside the shed.  The carriage in the foreground is Taff Vale Railway 220, which was restored by staff and pupils at Brynteg Comprehensive School, and which has been based at the Gwili Railway since its restoration.  I think - but am not sure, that it is alongside a Taff Vale engine, but others may know more than me.  The depot at Cathays is now just a memory, and Cardiff University's Maindee campus now occupies the site.

More information about TVR220 can be found on the Gwili Railway Vintage Carriage Group's website at gvcg.co.uk/the-collection/#TVRCoach220
